fullStrategyPairedRaces.explanation: Attacks are independent of opponent attacks. Fixed fleets and alternating turns make outcomes exactly determined by shots-to-sink; first player wins equal-shot races. Every seed is evaluated in both first-player roles. Normal uses selected mixed layouts; Easy uses spaced layouts; HuntTarget uses random layouts.

limitations: Approximate biased constrained sampling, not exact posterior or optimal play.
Defensive strength requires the separate reported comparison; adjacency is not automatically stronger.
Wall-time protection can change decisions across devices; actual choices and diagnostics are saved in games.
CLI performance is not browser Worker latency or target-device FPS.
Human win rates and perceived fairness require playtests.
Source was reconstructed after environment replacement. Historical benchmark numbers are not validation of this source.
Timing measured with 4 concurrent benchmark shards; not isolated browser timing.
